;Arts and culture
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on cinema]]
**[[Cinema of China]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]]
***China's [[Film Bureau]] closes cinemas that had re-opened after the epidemic's first wave, without giving a reason. [https://www.theguardian.com/film/2020/mar/27/china-re-closes-all-cinemas-over-coronavirus-fears (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on religion]]
**[[Pope Francis]] delivers a special [[Urbi et Orbi]] blessing in an empty [[Saint Peter's Square]], praying for the end of the [[COVID-19 pandemic|coronavirus pandemic]] and offering a [[plenary indulgence]] to repentant sinners before [[San Marcello al Corso]]'s [[Miraculous plague cure of 1522|miraculous crucifix]], which was moved from its original church in [[Rome]] two days ago. [https://www.vaticannews.va/en/pope/news/2020-03/pope-francis-urbi-et-orbi-blessing-coronavirus.html (''Vatican News'')] [https://aleteia.org/2020/03/26/miraculous-crucifix-from-1522-plague-moved-to-st-peters-for-popes-urbi-et-orbi-blessing/ (Aleteia)]

;Business and economy
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
**The [[United States House of Representatives|House of Representatives]] passes a [[United States dollar|$]]2 trillion [[CARES Act|stimulus relief bill]] as an effort to save the economy during the coronavirus pandemic. [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]] signs the bill. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/house-passes-coronavirus-relief-stimulus-package-today-2020-03-27/ (CBS News)] [https://www.businessinsider.com/trump-signs-coronavirus-economic-relief-aid-bill-checks-for-americans-2020-3 (''Business Insider'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2020 New York City Subway fire]]
**One person is killed and 16 people are injured, four with life-threatening injuries, after a [[New York City Subway]] caught fire near the [[Central Park North–110th Street station]] in [[Harlem]]. The fire has been treated as suspicious. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/one-dead-least-16-hurt-new-york-city-subway-fire-n1170231 (NBC News)]
*[[Mount Merapi]] erupts in [[Indonesia]], sending ash of 5 kilometers in the air. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2020/03/29/news/world/indonesias-mt-merapi-erupts/707657/ (''Manila Times'')]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Uzbekistan]]
****[[Uzbekistan]] reports the first death from [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]], a 72-year-old woman with underlying health conditions in the city of [[Namangan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-uzbekistan/uzbekistan-reports-first-coronavirus-death-as-it-widens-lockdowns-idUSKBN21E0GK (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****In [[Iran]], 300 people die and 1,000 people become ill after drinking [[methanol]] to save themselves from COVID-19. [https://www.startribune.com/in-iran-false-belief-a-poison-fights-virus-kills-hundreds/569152742/ (''Star Tribune'')]
****Olympic silver medalist [[Ehsan Haddadi]] tests positive for COVID-19. [https://www.isna.ir/news/99010803905/تست_کرونای_احسان_حدادی_مثبت_شد (ISNA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****The [[Philippines]] passes a legislation granting emergency powers to President [[Rodrigo Duterte]] as part of its measures to deal with the coronavirus pandemic as confirmed cases rise to 707. [https://www.voanews.com/science-health/coronavirus-outbreak/philippines-declares-coronavirus-emergency-amid-state-warfare (Voice of America)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Jordan]]
****[[Jordan]] reports its first death from COVID-19, a woman in her 80s, as cases rise to 235. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-jordan/jordan-reports-first-coronavirus-death-state-news-agency-idUKKBN21E3HJ (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Africa]]
****[[South Africa]] reports its first two deaths from COVID-19, both occurring at hospitals in [[Western Cape]] province. The [[government of South Africa|government]] also announces a 21-day lockdown as cases surpass 1,000. [https://gulfnews.com/world/africa/south-africa-covid-19-cases-exceed-1000-first-two-deaths-reported-1.70657012 (''Gulf News'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****The number of people who tested positive in [[Italy]] jumps to 86,498, while the death toll rose to 9,134. Italy is the country with the highest death toll in the world and second for number of cases. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-52067673 (BBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|Prime Minister]] [[Boris Johnson]] tests positive for COVID-19. He will self-isolate at [[10 Downing Street]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-52060791 (BBC News)]
****[[Secretary of State for Health and Social Care]] [[Matt Hancock]] tests positive for COVID-19. [https://www.theguardian.com/politics/live/2020/mar/27/uk-coronavirus-live-rough-sleepers-nhs-applause-covid-19-latest-news (''The Guardian'')]
****The [[Department of Health and Social Care]] reports 185 more deaths from COVID-19, the highest daily death toll in the country to date, bringing the death toll in the [[United Kingdom]] to 769. [https://news.sky.com/story/coronavirus-uk-deaths-rise-by-182-to-766-11964567 (Sky News)]
****Scientists in [[Oxford]] are expected to recruit 510 adults without COVID-19 to test a [[COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/mar/27/uk-scientists-enrol-volunteers-for-coronavirus-vaccine-trial (''The Guardian'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Scotland]], [[Healthcare in Scotland]]
*****[[List of hospitals in Scotland|Hospitals]] in [[Scotland]] are expected to get testing kits from [[South Korea]] as an effort to increase testing for COVID-19. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-scotland-52068752 (BBC News)]
****A temporary [[mortuary]] is being built at [[Birmingham Airport]], with capacity to hold up to 12,000 bodies as the virus spreads in the region. [https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2020/mar/27/temporary-mortuary-being-built-at-birmingham-airport (''The Guardian'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[President of Russia|President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] orders that the week between 28 March and 5 April will be a nationwide paid holiday and declares the closing of all restaurants and shops during this week. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2020/03/27/coronavirus-in-russia-the-latest-news-march-27-a69117 (''The Moscow Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hungary]]
****[[Prime Minister of Hungary|Prime Minister]] [[Viktor Orbán]] announces a two-week national lockdown in response to the coronavirus pandemic. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-hungary-restrictio/hungarys-pm-imposes-lockdown-seeks-more-powers-for-government-to-fight-coronavirus-idUKKBN21E0QG (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Cyprus]]
****[[Cyprus]]' government is set to release 50 prisoners in order to contain the spread of the virus in the island. [https://cyprus-mail.com/2020/03/27/coronavirus-around-50-prisoners-to-be-released-reports/ (''Cyprus Mail'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[Governor of New York|New York Governor]] [[Andrew Cuomo]] announces that eight hospitals will be built as the number of cases in [[COVID-19 pandemic in New York (state)|New York]] surge. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-usa-new-york/new-york-to-build-eight-temporary-hospitals-braces-for-surge-in-patients-cuomo-says-idUKKBN21E2KW (Reuters)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in California]]
*****The [[USNS Mercy (T-AH-19)|USNS ''Mercy'']], which has 1,000 beds, arrives in [[Los Angeles]] to offer assistance during the COVID-19 crisis. [https://www.latimes.com/california/story/2020-03-27/mercy-hospital-ship-with-1-000-beds-arrives-in-l-a-to-help-with-coronavirus (''Los Angeles Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Tonga]]
***Prime Minister [[Pohiva Tu'i'onetoa]] announces that the country would be under a lock-down between 29 March and 5 April. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/412708/tonga-declares-lockdown-starting-this-weekend (RNZ)]

;International relations
*[[China–United States relations]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
**[[Paramount leader|Chinese leader]] [[Xi Jinping]] offers advice to [[President of the United States|United States President]] Donald Trump on how to contain the coronavirus pandemic. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-china-toll/chinas-xi-offers-trump-help-in-coronavirus-fight-as-wuhan-reopens-to-traffic-idUKKBN21E02P (Reuters)]
*[[North Macedonia–NATO relations]]
**[[North Macedonia]] becomes the 30th member of [[NATO]] after over a year of negotiations. [https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2020/03/27/its-official-north-macedonia-becomes-natos-30th-member/ (Defense News)]
*[[Syria–United Arab Emirates relations]]
**Abu Dhabi crown prince [[Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan|Mohammed bin Zayed Al Nahyan]] and [[President of Syria|Syrian President]] [[Bashar al-Assad]] discusses the COVID-19 pandemic on phone. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-emirates-syria/abu-dhabi-crown-prince-syrian-president-discuss-coronavirus-idUSKBN21E391 (Reuters)]

;Science and technology
*[[Misinformation related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[Fox News controversies]]
***[[Fox Business]] fires its primetime host [[Trish Regan]] after she claimed the coronavirus is a [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic Party]] ploy to impeach President [[Donald Trump]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/03/27/media/trish-regan-fox-news/index.html (CNN)]

***The [[Utah Jazz]] announces that [[Rudy Gobert]] and [[Donovan Mitchell]] are cleared of coronavirus after becoming the first [[National Basketball Association]] players to test positive on March 11.
